fieldData.acrm---key-feature-4-content:
A list of who has not signed yet

Pick the hour, and the app emails your pre-op nurse every case on the next day's schedule that still has no signature. Each line on that list carries the patient's phone number.
fieldData.awb---key-feature-1-content:
No signature yet from 3 of Thursday's 22 patients

Marrowfield Surgery Center emails the consent link to every patient booked for surgery. Thursday has 22 cases on the schedule. At 2:00 PM on Wednesday, 19 of 22 are signed, and pre-op nurse Odette Rainsford gets an email listing the 3 patients who have not signed, each with a phone number to call.
fieldData.awb---mockup-data: window.awbMockup = { surgeryCenters: "I run a surgery center. Build a surgery consent form we email to every patient booked for surgery. At 2:00 PM the day before each surgery day, email our pre-op nurse a list of every patient on the next day's schedule who has not signed yet, with their phone number, so she can call them that afternoon.", surgeonOffices: "My orthopedic practice sends consent forms after each surgical consult. Let our surgical coordinator fill in the procedure, the side, the surgeon, and the surgery date first. The patient should see those lines as read-only, tick a box under each of our 4 consent sections, and e-sign. Save the signed form with the procedure exactly as the coordinator entered it.", veterinarySurgery: "We are an animal hospital. Build a surgery consent form that pet owners e-sign before a scheduled surgery. Ask for the pet's name and the owner's phone number, and let the owner choose what we do if something unplanned comes up: Call me first, or Proceed, then call. Show each owner's choice next to the pet's name on our daily surgery board.", interpretedConsent: "Our hospital has consent wording approved in English and Spanish. Let the patient pick a language on the first screen. When an interpreter helps, let the nurse enter the interpreter's name, ID number, and whether they joined in person or by phone before the signature screen, and save those details on the same record as the patient's signature and the time." };
fieldData.afb---prompt: Build a surgery consent form that saves every response to a database I own.
